abyssal.concept: The Deep, a dark ocean world lit only by its creatures; the young Abyssal Carriers rise from it into a black sky

abyssdrift.concept: An ice moon over an ore field, and something vast and slow moving in the dark beyond it

anchorreach.concept: Cranes and noodle stalls: a floating container yard round the hub, a glittering shard field out past it

add_bodies.name: The Hook
add_bodies.desc: A hooked moonlet the haulers tie off to. There is a bar in its crater that has never closed.

anchorwater.concept: A farm world with a cargo tether rising from its equator to an anchor platform, ore and gas fields on either side

anvilhelm-hold.concept: Two anvils facing each other across a gas field; one mines, one trades, and they argue about the difference

ashshade.concept: An ash-black world under a faint star; a short lamp line runs from its keeper's moon

add_bodies.name: Ashshade
add_bodies.desc: A world of grey ash and old lava plains. Nobody settled it. The Lamplighters say the ash is warm.

add_bodies.name: Keeper's Rock
add_bodies.desc: One beacon, one keeper, a year at a time.

astenna.concept: A new Concord customs ring and an autumn colony, ore and gas worked at the edges

add_bodies.name: Astenna Gate
add_bodies.desc: A Concord customs ring at the end of the line. Inspectors with very little to inspect, and very good coffee.

add_bodies.name: Astenna World
add_bodies.desc: An autumn-coloured colony of orchards and timber towns, settled by Concord families a generation ago.

astita.concept: An industrial waypoint with a fuel depot, a pulsar sweeping the sky

aureole.concept: A research ring on a long orbit round a dark primary, a lost probe drifting inward

axleford.concept: A caravan wheel at a ford in the ore field, under a storm-banded giant

axleway.concept: A repair moon with a broken caravan wheel tethered beside it, half its spokes missing

basaltdeep.concept: A mining anvil sunk into an asteroid the size of a moon, a smelter between twin ore fields, a drifting belt

basaltforge-deep.concept: A volcanic forge world, its locked moon scarred by a mining trench, ore fields above and below

basaltgard.concept: A volcanic forge world and its locked moon under a dim red star, three fields around it

bilgeyard.concept: A pirate den bolted together from stolen hulls, surrounded by the ones they have not bolted on yet

brasstrack-wells.concept: A desert world of brass towers and its caravan wheel; a shard field glints like brass in the sun

brightwater.concept: A water world of floating towns, with a mending dock in orbit where Spacer families fix their ships

broodhive.concept: A brood nursery in an empty system: one jungle world with a grown silo in orbit, a swarm over the ore field

add_bodies.name: Broodhive
add_bodies.desc: A hot, wet nursery world. The canopy is so thick the surface is always dark.

broodhollow.concept: The living spire where Brood Queens are raised, ringed by brood lattices and watched by ten thousand eyes

add_bodies.name: Broodhollow
add_bodies.desc: A warm, wet jungle world the brood are carried down to when they hatch.

caravanserai.concept: Serai, a desert world of tents and brass towers where the Grand Caravans winter, a caravanserai in orbit

caravantrack.concept: A repair moon on the caravan track, a gas field where caravans top up

chimeith-facet.concept: A crystal hall alone in a violet planetary nebula, its chimes tuned to the shell of gas around it

chitath.concept: An empty system the hive is just reaching: one seeded jungle moon, an ore field, a scout swarm

add_bodies.name: Chitath
add_bodies.desc: A moon the Vashari are seeding with jungle. Half of it is green; the other half is waiting.

chitinreach.concept: Molt, a moon carpeted in shed carapaces; grown harvest towers and a swarm work above it

cinderverge.concept: The Hollow fortress: an armoured stronghold with a gun platform in orbit, captured hulls left outside as a warning

coldharbor.concept: First landfall beyond the Gateway: the bridge-city, the old colony ships moored as a memorial, Concordia's light in the gate

copperharbor.concept: A copper-red mining world nobody had bothered to name until the Spacers arrived, ore and gas fields at its edges

add_bodies.name: Copperharbor
add_bodies.desc: A rust-red world with long dry valleys. The Spacer camps here smelt copper in the open air.

copperwell.concept: A lone port in an amber haze, waiting for contracts

coralreef-current.concept: An ice moon with a warm sea, a reef bloom circling it

coralwake.concept: The Reef, grown in orbit and glowing pink and blue, Polyp Darts spawning round it in clouds

corora.concept: A waypoint in the shadow of a huge storm-banded giant

dimmer.concept: An empty reach where the Hollow hide: one ore field, one dark rogue moon, and the only light their running lamps

add_bodies.name: Dimmer Rock
add_bodies.desc: A dark wandering moon that drifted in and stayed. Hollow crews lie up in its caves between raids.

driftyard.concept: A breakers' yard: a short row of old hulls moored side by side waiting to be cut, one in a cutting frame, a big hulk half stripped

add_bodies.name: Driftyard Camp
add_bodies.desc: Spacer breakers live here among the hulls they are cutting up. Anything that still works is for sale.

duneroad-market.concept: A caravan wheel at the market crossroads of an ore field and a shard field

dunpeak.concept: A volcanic forge world between three fields, a smelter platform in orbit

dunstone-hold.concept: A quarry moon ringing with hammers under a swollen red giant

ebbreef.concept: An ocean world between two gas fields, waterbells and ice drifting on the tide

elasai.concept: A silent watch moon between two gas fields, blue sails turning slowly beside it

ember-drift.concept: Grey seas under a swollen red giant, a gas field and a broken shard field glinting in the twilight

emberburn.concept: A dim world with lamps on its ridges, an ice moon cracked into plates, an ore field to the north

emberlight.concept: Keeper's Vigil, an amber desert with a lamp on every hill, a shard field glowing like embers

emberwake.concept: A dim world with lamps on its ridges; a keepers' lighthouse marks the edge of the shard field

facetfall.concept: Facet, a world of crystal plains that ring in the wind; a tuned chime circles it, crystal drifts in from the field

facethymn-chord.concept: A ringing world with a great chime circling it

facetsene.concept: An empty system with a slowly growing crystal: the Ylith seeded it a century ago and come back to listen

add_bodies.name: The Seed
add_bodies.desc: A seeded crystal moon still growing. Every century it rings a note lower.

facetvane-facet.concept: A split crystal moon and an ore field the Ylith mine for tuning stone

farhaul.concept: The long way round: a few tired relay buoys, a hauler that ran out of fuel and was left where it stopped

add_bodies.name: Farhaul Relay
add_bodies.desc: A refuelling relay a day from anywhere. The logbook in the galley goes back a hundred years.

farmouth.concept: The Threshold, a white spire at the edge of Que'vari space; sails mark the way in, the sky turns blue

fathompool.concept: An orbital reef over a gas field; kelp streamers trail from it for kilometres

fathomtrench.concept: An ocean world with a deep trench that glows at night; waterbells rise from it

flickerfall.concept: A vigil port between two gas fields, one of them flaring into an ion storm; keepers lamp the safe route

flickerglow.concept: Two dim worlds linked by a lamp chain, a red gas field glowing between them

gallowsden.concept: A scorched world with two captured ships left near it, a lumpy captured moon

geodesy.concept: Geode, a moon split open to its violet heart, crystal drifting out of the split

glasswake.concept: A foundry over a shattered world: the remnant moon, glittering shards, a smelter working the pieces

gloam.concept: An outlaw moon in a cloud of wreckage by a pulsar, a shard field glinting with stolen cargo

gloammark-night.concept: A light-drinking world under a dim red star; thin red filaments cross a sky with almost nothing else in it

gravehole.concept: A wreck-strewn moon where the Hollow strip their prizes, and the remains of the last fleet that came to stop them

greyline.concept: Two pale moons covered in unreadable markers, an ancient ring in the ore field, old buoys nobody placed

grimpeak-deep.concept: Two gas fields and a smelter platform in an otherwise empty, soot-dark system

add_bodies.name: Grimpeak Smelter
add_bodies.desc: A Korrund smelter that burns gas to cook ore. The soot drifts for a thousand kilometres.

gutteryard-den.concept: Two scorched worlds facing each other under a red giant, Hollow crews on both, one wreck between them

gutteryard.concept: A moon where the Hollow strip their prizes; a cutting rig and a couple of gutted hulls beside it

halcyon.concept: A garden world of harbours under a soft sky and a jewel-like planetary nebula

hearthlight.concept: The warmest of the Lamplighter worlds: a big hearth world with lit towns and a gas field glowing beyond

hesper.concept: Lanternfall, a dark ring kilometres across leaking warm light, and a single lamp-lit lane running from it into the dark

add_bodies.name: Hesper
add_bodies.desc: An amber world kept for the Lamplighters' dead. Every grave has a lamp.

hivemire.concept: A humid hive world thrumming with wings, a lumpy captured moon, an ore field netted with grown cables

hookhole.concept: A lone scorched world with three broken raiders caught in its orbit

hookyard.concept: A scorched world with two dusty moons, gas and ore fields worked by press-ganged crews

hushvoid.concept: An Umbral port in total silence: no nebula, a few far galaxies, and a swarm drifting just beyond the ore field

iriace.concept: Two crystal halls, one above the other, with chimes along the way between them

add_bodies.name: Iriace
add_bodies.desc: A violet crystal world the halls take their tuning from. Its plains hum at dawn.

iridell.concept: Two ringing worlds with chimes between them, a shard field and an ore field

ironpeak-forge.concept: Two anvils on a gas field, a smelter between them, soot drifting across the sun

ironpost.concept: Two rival exchanges facing each other across a lane, a fuel moon between them

add_bodies.name: Tank
add_bodies.desc: A fuel moon split between the two exchanges by a line painted across it. Nobody crosses the line.

ironwell-market.concept: A fuel moon between two ore fields, a crushed freighter nobody has cleared

kelpbloom.concept: An orbital reef between two gas fields; kelp blooms trail off toward both like long green hair

knifemaw.concept: A scorched outlaw world under a white dwarf, with one blade-shaped hulk across the ore field

kragdelve.concept: An empty system with a deep-mined asteroid the Korrund are hollowing into a new hold

add_bodies.name: Kragdelve
add_bodies.desc: A big asteroid being hollowed into a hold. Its forge vents glow along the fault lines.

kraggard.concept: A mining anvil in a captured asteroid; slag dumped from it drifts in a glowing trail

lantern-twins.concept: The expedition exchange between an ember sun and its blue companion, a few supply buoys out toward the cinder world

longhaul.concept: The family depot by a skimmed gas field, a frozen moon with one dome and a very good bar

longreach.concept: A farm world and its port; a quiet lane between them

lowtide.concept: A trading ring built for a colony that never came, over a cold ocean world settlers are only now claiming

add_bodies.name: Lowtide
add_bodies.desc: A cold ocean world with one wide bay of shallow water that drains and fills with the moon. The camps follow the tide line.

luora.concept: An empty, peaceful system: one gas field and a crystal garden the Que'vari tend

add_bodies.name: Luora Garden
add_bodies.desc: A crystal moon. The Que'vari grow its spires slowly and sing to them.

lyrene.concept: The beacon star: a waypoint with a nav buoy circling it, under a small red sun

maggard.concept: A volcanic forge world on its own; lava rivers on the night side, an orbital forge glowing above them

maghelm-hold.concept: A mining anvil and two ore fields; a wrecked ore-hauler broken over the rocks where it misjudged the approach

mandihive.concept: A chitin-harvest moon and a grown silo ring, an ore field off toward the gold-green sky

mandikesh.concept: A humid hive world, its grown spire in orbit, a harvest swarm over the ore field

meridian.concept: Shipyards under a red and blue pair: slipway frames, half-built hulls, a scrapyard

mirrorfall.concept: An ore field that throws sunlight like broken glass, a small mining moon, a white dwarf

add_bodies.name: Mirrorfall Claim
add_bodies.desc: A captured rock with a mining camp dug into its shadow side. The crews call the ore field "the mirror".

mountainhold.concept: Hold, a world that is mostly mountain; the mountain-lords' forges glow along its ridges, an anvil moon in orbit

add_bodies.name: The Anvil
add_bodies.desc: A moon hollowed into one great forge. The hammering can be felt through a docked hull.

nightjar.concept: A sunless rogue world lit only by its refuge domes, an emergency beacon, a sky of distant galaxies

ninefold.concept: Nine domed towns on a grey sea world, a shared gas field, a shard field far out

northmark.concept: The last waystation before the dark: a lost convoy escort in the shard field, a patrol buoy circling the station

novion.concept: A blue colony between two ore fields, mining depots, and a swollen red giant in the sky

novium-verge.concept: A tidy colony under a shell of orbital mirrors, a scooped gas giant hanging close

nulreach.concept: Two gas fields in the dark; between them an Umbral lattice that hums when ships pass, and one cold globule overhead

add_bodies.name: The Lattice
add_bodies.desc: An Umbral structure that does not respond to hails. Ships that dock come back quieter.

nulward.concept: A white dwarf behind a thin veil, a gas field, and a derelict Umbral spire turning slowly with lights that come and go

opalace-facet.concept: A crystal hall over an opal shard field that throws coloured light across the whole system

opalvane.concept: A split moon showing its violet heart, under a pale lilac giant

palinode.concept: A settler annex beside an ancient builders' observatory; the arrays still listen, an old gate stands nearby

praeenna.concept: A relay beside a gold crystal field, a planetary nebula filling the sky

add_bodies.name: Praeenna Veil
add_bodies.desc: A ringed ice world. The relay crews ski its glacier belts on leave.

qgate.concept: The capital: an ocean world inside a white mirror ring, a patrol satellite in orbit

quevar.concept: Ina Lumen, the Que'vari homeworld: white cities under sails of pale blue light, a sail-yard in orbit

quietude.concept: A waystation built from ships that never went home; two of the unused hulls are still moored beside it

reliquary.concept: A shielded salvage watch by the pulsar graveyard; a dead battleship and a handful of smaller wrecks near the scorched husk moon

resonance.concept: Choirhall, where the great carriers are grown like frost; crystal grows in the space around it

ropewater-rest.concept: A raft of family ships lashed together between two gas fields, the whole flotilla drifting as one

add_bodies.name: Ropewater Raft
add_bodies.desc: Thirty family ships tied hull to hull. Weddings, funerals and arguments all happen on the central deck.

rustverge.concept: A scorched world, a pirate port in the ore field, a burnt-out escape pod drifting past

sable-reach.concept: A skimming camp on a pale moon under a dark banded giant, a refinery working the gas field

saddlerest-market.concept: A repair-moon market between two gas fields, in a bright gold haze

saddletrack.concept: A broad red desert world with a caravan wheel at anchor

sconcefall-vigil.concept: A vigil station and a beacon moon, three lamps marking the short way between them

scrapverge.concept: A black market made of scrap, smuggler hulls parked beside it, a gas field full of hidden caches

seimira.concept: A white spire over a quiet field, a pale ice world, a blue-white sky

add_bodies.name: Seimira
add_bodies.desc: A pale ice world the Que'vari keep for its silence. Pilgrims walk its glaciers.

serita.concept: A customs post: inspection gates on the approach lane, an ocean world below

add_bodies.name: Serita Minor
add_bodies.desc: A temperate ocean world whose island towns keep the relay fed. Customs officers retire to its beaches.

shoalbloom.concept: A reef in orbit of a great ocean world, Polyp Dart clouds drifting between them

shoaldeep.concept: An orbital reef above an empty deep; a leviathan skeleton drifts near it, picked clean and glowing

shoaldrift.concept: An ice moon in a field of drifting icebergs, a gas field beyond, a pale blue giant over it all

shoalight.concept: A sail-yard where electro-sails are woven, finished sails hung out in the light

shoalpool.concept: Two ocean worlds close enough to raise tides on each other; bells drift between them

skrrspire.concept: Two gas fields worked by grown skimmers; a hive spire seeded in the empty middle of the system

add_bodies.name: Skrrspire
add_bodies.desc: A young hive spire still growing. Its walls are soft and its docks change shape between visits.

slagforge.concept: Slag, a volcanic world crusted in black glass with orange rivers, its forges in orbit

sol.concept: Humanity's home in the Rift: Terra's relay ring and the lunar slipways

sparfall.concept: A crystal hall in a slow fall of shards, the glittering debris of a crystal moon that sang itself apart

sparith-facet.concept: A ringing crystal world and a shard field far out, chimes along the lane between them

sparvane.concept: A crystal hall between two shard fields, tuned chimes out toward the far field

spokeroad.concept: Spoke, the great wheel where caravans gather, music on the comms

spokeserai.concept: Two caravan wheels facing each other across the system

surfwake-current.concept: An ice moon with a warm sea beneath, a couple of icebergs nearby, a waterbell circling it

tapermere.concept: A broad dim world under a dull star, a keepers' chapel in orbit, lamps marking both fields

add_bodies.name: Tapermere Chapel
add_bodies.desc: A small dark station where keepers light a lamp for each ship lost on their lanes.

tapershade.concept: A dim world with a lumpy captured moonlet, a lamp on each of its points

thrmire.concept: A swamp-green gas giant fills the sky; the hive harvests its gas field and the ore field far beyond

add_bodies.name: Thrmire
add_bodies.desc: A humid moon under the green giant, wrapped in grown harvest-towers.

thrumhive.concept: Thrum, a jungle world humming with a billion wings; a grown spire circles it and a swarm drifts nearby

tidepool.concept: Tide, a world of one endless ocean; shining bells of living water rise to meet visitors in orbit

tinpost-market.concept: A fuel-moon market with a trading post on the approach

umbra.concept: The Dark Heart: a world that drinks light, a black hole off in the dark, a faint veil, and spires that should not be there

valeon.concept: A quiet colony under a ring galaxy and a white dwarf stripping a red giant

valora-prime.concept: Terraced city world under a blue-white giant, a few big mirror dishes and a pair of patrol drones in orbit

valora.concept: An anchorage before a torn supernova shell, a pale ringed ice giant close by

vantdeep-night.concept: A light-drinking world and a frost-streaked moon; the shard field glows faintly from inside, the only colour here

vantvoid.concept: A single world that seems to drink light, no sun to speak of, and a newborn star glowing somewhere far beyond

vesper-gate.concept: An ancient builders' ring with nothing in it, which the settlers call a gate, beside a quiet ore field

add_bodies.name: Vesper Camp
add_bodies.desc: Prospectors who came to study the empty ring and stayed to mine. They are still waiting for it to open.

vespervoid.concept: An Umbral anchorage nobody docks at twice, two hulks of ships that tried beside it, a black hole for a sun

vigilfall-lantern.concept: A vigil station at the end of a lamp line that threads safely through an ore field

vrrath-clutch.concept: Two hive worlds and their moons, a swarm crossing between them

vrrath.concept: A chitin moon and a gas field worked by a grown silo

vrrhive.concept: A chitin-harvest moon under a green gas giant; grown silos and a swarm above the carapace fields

wagonford.concept: A lilac desert world, an ore field, and the odd caravan crossing

wagonrest.concept: A desert world of tents and brass between two ore fields

wagonroad.concept: An empty stretch of the road: one brass beacon tower and the dust of caravans long gone

add_bodies.name: Wagonroad Tower
add_bodies.desc: A brass beacon tower on the caravan road. Travellers scratch their names into its hull.

waystation.concept: The crossroads market: a bazaar ring and a trading post where every lane in the Rift meets

wheelwright.concept: A repair moon where wheelwrights straighten bent spokes; a damaged caravan wheel hangs in a cradle beside it

wickburn-watch.concept: A broad lamp-lit world and the watch tower in orbit that guides ships through the ore field

add_bodies.name: Wickburn Tower
add_bodies.desc: A thin tower of dark metal with a lamp at the top. The watch keeps a light for every ship expected.

zzclutch.concept: A chitin moon and a grown spire between two gas fields, the clutch swarm drifting between them
